faq.question: What is SEO & AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO)?
faq.answer: SEO & AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO) is an advanced 10-week, 80-hour specialization that bridges traditional technical search engine optimization with next-generation AI discovery. You will learn technical SEO audits, site speed optimization, semantic content clusters, Schema.org knowledge graphs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to rank on Google while earning authoritative citations across Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search.

faq.question: How does Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) differ from traditional SEO?
faq.answer: Traditional SEO focuses on earning organic rankings among the '10 blue links' through keywords, backlinks, and on-page optimization. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focuses on getting your content and brand cited as an authoritative source in AI-generated answers synthesized by large language models like Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search.

faq.question: What are the course fees and duration?
faq.answer: The course duration is 10 Weeks (80 instructional and guided lab hours). The institutional fee is INR 12,900 (+ applicable GST), adhering strictly to Nova Skills' Truth in Pricing policy with zero fake countdown timers or inflated discounts.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: The course is designed as a Specialist Certification. While it starts from technical crawl fundamentals and keyword intent, basic digital literacy and familiarity with websites are recommended. All technical audits use guided tools like Screaming Frog and Google Search Console with step-by-step instructor mentorship.

faq.question: What tools and software will I learn?
faq.answer: You will master Google Search Console, Screaming Frog SEO Spider, SEMrush/Ahrefs workflows, Schema.org Validator, Google Rich Results Test, PageSpeed Insights, Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, and Looker Studio. All exercises use free tool tiers or simulation datasets without requiring paid subscriptions.

faq.question: Does the course cover technical SEO and Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 01 is dedicated to Search Engine Architecture & Technical SEO Audits, covering crawl budget, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, HTTP status codes, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) diagnosis and remediation.

faq.question: How does the course teach optimization for Perplexity and ChatGPT Search?
faq.answer: Modules 04 and 05 specifically focus on GEO and AEO. You will learn how LLM answer engines retrieve and synthesize web information, how to structure content with high factual density and authoritative citations, how to inject entity knowledge graphs, and how to track brand mentions across conversational engines.

faq.question: Are practical portfolio projects included?
faq.answer: Yes. You will complete three comprehensive portfolio deliverables: (1) a full Technical SEO Audit & Developer Remediation Plan, (2) a Semantic Topical Authority Architecture & Entity Schema Graph, and (3) a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Citation Playbook.

faq.question: Will I learn Google Search Console and Looker Studio reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 06 covers Search Performance Diagnostics, Google Search Console index coverage and query log analysis, and building automated, client-ready organic search reporting dashboards in Looker Studio.

faq.question: What career opportunities are available after completing this course?
faq.answer: Graduates qualify for high-demand roles including SEO & AI Search Specialist, Technical SEO Executive, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Consultant, Organic Growth Marketing Manager, and Search Strategist, as well as lucrative freelance technical audit retainers.
